description: E08 Concept-Flow mix: reasoning-trace-heavy distillation data (problem->CoT->answer) for the flow reasoner's concept-space targets, balanced with a web/code fluency replay so the warm-started crystallizer holds STS-B. Reasoning ~50%, fluency ~50% (a ~5x boost in reasoning share vs smollm3_inspired_2k_e05).

long_context_policy.notes: Reasoning traces skew long, but at seq 2048 traces exceeding ~2K (problem+solution) are filtered to keep the full answer visible. A 4K long-trace variant is a CF-1 option, not E08.

sources.name: openmathreasoning_cot
sources.notes: PRIMARY reasoning source. Explicit problem + generated_solution columns let the reasoning_distillation collator encode the question and the trace SEPARATELY (question -> z0, trace/answer -> flow targets). cot split only.

sources.name: big_reasoning_traces
sources.notes: Diverse long DeepSeek CoT traces; also stresses cross-window concept memory. Flat text column -> collator falls back to prefix_suffix-style splitting for the flow target.

sources.name: fineweb_edu
sources.notes: Web fluency replay to retain STS-B / language ability in the warm-started crystallizer.

expected_length_profile_from_2026_06_20_.estimation_notes: Reasoning traces lift the long tail vs pure web mixes, but seq-2048 filtering caps it. Re-measure with analysis/dataset_seqlen_distribution.py after the recipe is finalized.

variants.reasoning_heavy_60_40: Bump openmathreasoning_cot -> 0.40, big_reasoning_traces -> 0.20 (reasoning 60%); trim fineweb_edu -> 0.18, dclm -> 0.12. Use only if the 50/50 keystone holds STS-B >= 0.65 and we want a stronger reasoning signal.
